mask-headers.description: Header name patterns to mask in history entries. Supports trailing wildcard (e.g., 'X-Internal-*').

verbose.description: Include the full validator envelope (howToFix, validationType, requestPath, referenceSchema, ...) in validation-failure responses. Default returns a slim shape with only reason + nested validationErrors.

timeout.description: Maximum time a single validate call may run before being abandoned (Go duration format, e.g. '500ms', '5s'). Pathological specs can send the validator's schema render into runaway recursion; on timeout the request proceeds without validation. Default 1s.

replay.description: Replay (VCR-like) configuration: record API responses and replay them on subsequent requests matching specific payload criteria.

upstream-only.description: Only record responses from upstream services.

auto-replay.description: Activate replay for configured endpoints without requiring the X-Mockzilla-Replay header.

endpoints.description: Map of path patterns to HTTP methods and their match configurations.

additionalProperties.description: HTTP methods for this path pattern.

match.description: Dotted paths into request body to extract match values (e.g., 'data.name', 'data.address.zip').

optional-properties.description: Controls how many optional properties to keep. When not set, all optional properties are kept.

min.description: Minimum number of optional properties to keep.

max.description: Maximum number of optional properties to keep.

mount.description: URL prefix at which the service mounts (may contain `/`, e.g. `pets/v2`). Defaults to `/<service-name>` (the service folder name).

headers.description: Headers to add to upstream requests.

fail-on.description: HTTP status codes to return directly to the client without falling back to the generator. Default: 400-499 except 401, 403. Set to empty array to disable.

sticky-timeout.description: When a request falls back to the generator, all subsequent requests to this service skip upstream for this duration (e.g., '30s'). 0 or omitted = disabled.

except.description: Status codes to exclude from matching.

body.description: Refine fail-on rules based on response body JSON fields.

default.description: Decides the outcome when neither fail nor except conditions match, or when both match.

fail.description: Always fail (return error to client) when ALL conditions match.

except.description: Never fail (fall through to generator) when ALL conditions match.

body-match-condition.description: A condition matching a JSON field in the response body.

path.description: Dot-notation path to a JSON field (e.g., 'error.detail.code').

equals.description: Value to compare against. Supports string, number, or boolean.
